note: Numbered authority for behavior Qin has explicitly retained. A capability stays mandatory until Qin retires it; a new feature may extend this catalog but may never silently drop an entry (release_gate.py enforces a minimum count and contiguous ids). Every text check matches only text that is IN FORCE: HTML comments, <details> blocks and fenced code (including nested fences) are stripped first, and 'section' checks require an exact section heading, so a deleted rule cannot be revived by parking its wording somewhere inert. Every 'script' check must also REJECT a synthetic known-bad fixture, so an emptied or stubbed checker cannot pass. Known limit, stated rather than pretended: the 'absent' scans are literal patterns over normalized text — they catch spelling and case variants listed here, not unicode homoglyphs or arbitrary paraphrase. They defend against accidental regression, not a determined saboteur with commit access. Paths are repo-root relative.
